pages.title: Silicon Life Spore
pages.text: A spore built on silicon instead of carbon - a speculative chemistry that only works in the strange physics of the Bulk. It is glassy, faceted and very slightly warm, and it ticks quietly, as though growing at the pace of crystal.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Silicon life has always been a thought experiment. In the Bulk, where chemistry runs differently, I seeded a minimal cell with a xenogenome and Xenoplasm on a bulk crystal. The spore that grew was neither carbon nor stone.
